summary: Iteration 3: tested payment methods, owner reports (period/calendar/by_courier), geocoded pickup/dest coords, courier pickup/deliver flow with photo+note, photo download auth, courier totals. Backend 49/49 pytest pass (run serially). Frontend: all requested owner + courier flows work on 375x667 web preview, including real photo upload via web file chooser and owner 'Comprobante de entrega' showing photo + note. Only minor UX/code-review findings. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: Full long-lived JWT is put in the image URL query string (src/api.ts:11). It can leak through proxy/access logs, browser history and caches. Better: a short-lived signed photo token or fetching with an Authorization header.

Couriers can close a delivery without a photo. The backend does not require delivery_photo, and the UI labels the photo 'Foto de la entrega (opcional)'. The user asked couriers to take a photo BEFORE delivering. Confirm with the user whether the photo should be required.
If the business has no lat/lng when the order is created, pickup_lat stays null for good. create_order sets geo_tried=True, so ensure_coords later returns early and never geocodes the business.

The payment method can still be changed on delivered or cancelled orders: there is no closed-order check, and the detail-payment chips stay active after delivery. This may be intentional (to correct mistakes) but changes past reports.

ui_bugs.issue: After using report-prev/report-next in 'Mes', shiftPeriod returns the 1st of the month. Switching to 'Día' then shows 'Jueves 1 de octubre' at 0,00 € instead of today (Oct 29). Reference: src/period.ts:34-37 (shiftPeriod for 'mes' returns addMonths(startOfMonth)). Keep the day of month, or reset to today when returning to the current period.

issues: trip-point-pickup shows only the business name (e.g. 'Pizzería Napoli'), not the pickup address. The owner detail shows 'Café Aroma · Calle de Fuencarral 45'. The stop rows below do show the address, so this is minor.
Old seed order #1002 still shows an Argentine address ('Calle Lavalle 845'). The demo data move to Madrid did not update delivered seed orders.

react_native_issues.issue: app.json has no android.config.googleMaps.apiKey. The map works in Expo Go, but a standalone/EAS Android build will show a blank map without a Google Maps API key. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json

action_items: LOW: Decide whether the delivery photo should be required before 'Confirmar entrega' (user wording: 'take a photo and add a note BEFORE delivering'). If so, enforce it in CloseDeliverySheet and in the backend courier_status for 'entregado'.
LOW: Fix shiftPeriod('mes') so that switching to 'Día' after navigating does not jump to the 1st of the month.
LOW: Avoid the raw JWT in the photo URL query (use a short-lived signed token).
LOW: In create_order, do not set geo_tried=True when the business has no coordinates (or geocode the business at creation).
LOW: Add android.config.googleMaps.apiKey for production Android builds of react-native-maps.
LOW: Optionally show the pickup address in TripMap.web trip-point-pickup on the courier screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 936 lines (>700). Consider splitting into routers (auth, orders, courier, reports, storage/geocode).
reports(): the by_courier loop and the aggregation pipeline both go over the same docs. Computing everything from the already-fetched docs would remove the second DB round-trip.

Backend tests share one owner account. Under pytest-xdist (default -n) test_report_totals_delta and test_order_flow fail because other workers create orders in the same window. Run with -n0 or isolate the data per worker.
Changes to files under backend/tests trigger a uvicorn reload (WatchFiles), which can cause flaky failures while tests are being edited.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows passed; 1 low-priority UX bug

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI orders #1154 and #1155 (owner UI + courier deliver, one with a photo). Deleted after testing. The uploaded test PNG stays in object storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with `pytest -n0` (xdist parallelism causes data-race failures in the delta-based report tests). Courier login uses tab testID login-tab-courier. Close-delivery sheet slides in: wait about 1s before clicking confirm-delivery-button. On web, take-photo-button opens a file chooser (page.expect_file_chooser works). Order numbers are sequential (last 1155).
